🔔 What's the biggest IPO ever? It depends how you count.

For years the record holder was Saudi Aramco, which raised $25.6 billion when it listed in 2019. This year, two new giants changed the list: SpaceX and Anthropic.

We ranked the 10 biggest IPOs ever, with sources on screen for every record.

An IPO (initial public offering) is when a company first sells its shares to the public on a stock exchange.

▶️ Watch the full top 10 on our YouTube channel (link in bio): https://youtu.be/FHttKROwlGQ

Education, not financial advice.
